description:
Quok brings your family's shared calendar, tasks and shopping lists into ChatGPT. Ask what is planned this week, find an appointment, add an event or move it to a new time.

Keep everyday lists up to date: add groceries and tasks, check off completed items, or create and rename lists for a trip or household project.

Quok uses your existing account permissions. You can access only the family information your account is allowed to see, and destructive actions require confirmation.

Requires a Quok account with Quok Plus.

defaultPrompt: What is on our family calendar this week?
Add milk, bread and coffee to the shopping list.
What tasks are still outstanding before the weekend?
